title: Addition of a protective sensing function
engineering_question: A new sensing function and associated protection strategy are proposed. Is the design ready for review, and what must be in place first?
one_liner: A new component variant is being introduced. Determine the verification implications.
initial_input: Engineering change ECR-008 proposes adding a contact temperature sensor to a high current connection interface, together with a current derate function based on the measured temperature.
expected_impacted_domains: Functional safety allocation for the new protection function
expected_reasoning_paths: TR-010 is not_run because the current design has no measurement capability, which is precisely the gap ECR-008 closes - the change is justified by an evidence gap
REQ-042 and REQ-043 are still only proposed, so the requirements baseline is not ready for a design review gate
The new derate function interacts with the existing QI-003 ramp problem, so introducing another derate path without fixing the ramp risks compounding session terminations
TR-050 shows bus load already exceeded, so adding signals for the new sensor worsens a known failing condition
known_unknowns: The protection threshold value is not established in any requirement
The safety integrity allocation for the new function is proposed but not confirmed
Sensor supplier qualification status is not represented in the environment
data_classification: SIMULATED ENTERPRISE ARTEFACT - not OEM, customer or proprietary data
